item: Three diagnostics downloads that append to the run log refuse another site's page (F3); the performance report's keyword_mentions count obeys the member deadline (S3)
summary: Serving a diagnostics file appends a begin and an end line to diagnostics/runs.jsonl (and its .lock); three GETs did that without the R278 guard, so another site's page could make them append (Q's seeded ratchet, finding F3). /all-job/download, /all-job/volumes/{name} and /keywords/parts/{set_id}/{name} now carry refuse_cross_site_get; a test plants each file, proves a same-origin request writes the log, and proves a foreign Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site gets 403 with the log byte-identical (removing any one guard fails it). S3: the performance report counted keyword_mentions with a bare COUNT(*), one VM opcode, so the member deadline's progress handler was never asked and the deadline could not stop it; it is COUNT(1) now (about 3 opcodes a row), tested at the real statement_deadline of 1e-6 s on 40,000 rows with a control that a bare COUNT(*) returns whole. The same bare count remains in src/monitoring/benchmark.py:417 and rollup_benchmark.py:153 (other owners, reported). The cross_site.py docstring no longer says the backup route is to be pointed here later.
